programs.title: Serengeti
programs.desc: Viewers will see up close the everyday life of animals living in the pristine areas of the African Serengeti Park.In the next season of the nature series, they will learn the fate of new characters.The paradise landscapes of the Serengeti plain are just an illusion.There are many dangers and challenging days for the animals there.Kali the lioness and Bakari the baboon seem safe in their rock hideouts.On all sides, they are motivated by competition.Duma the cheetah faces his fate, and Mafuta the hippopotamus befriends Magamba the crocodile on the river.

programs.title: Ben Fogle: Return to the Wild
programs.desc: Adventurer Ben Fogle again visits daredevils who gave up their comfortable city life and moved to the bosom of nature.

programs.title: Solar System
programs.desc: The host of the program, Professor Brian Cox, presents selected information about the solar system.Viewers will learn about planets and moons covered with volcanoes that erupt with fire and ice.In the following parts, the scientist talks about the most interesting atmospheric conditions that were noticed on celestial bodies neighboring the Earth.He visits landscapes created by dust whirls, mountains covered with metallic frost and monsoon rains on one of the moons.In addition, Professor Cox will introduce viewers to frozen regions of the solar system, including a dwarf planet with mountains of solid ice floating on it, as well as a black and white moon.

programs.title: Seven Worlds, One Planet: Making Of
programs.desc: Material showing the behind-the-scenes of the nature production "Seven Worlds, One Planet".

programs.title: The World's Most Scenic Railway Journeys
programs.desc: The creators of the series go on a train journey to various places around the world.During each expedition, they meet people who live in specific areas or work on the most unique railway routes.They will also discover the wonders of nature that can be admired from the train windows.They will talk to engineers responsible for maintaining the lines and historians who will talk about the circumstances of their construction and the difficulties their builders faced.Viewers will be able to admire the landscapes of Norway, New Zealand, Canada, Switzerland, Wales and Spain.

programs.title: It Takes a Flood...
programs.desc: Meetings with people affected by the floods hitting Great Britain.Residents are counting their losses.It turns out that one in six British homes is in a flood risk area.
